verdict.rationale: Docs show a permissions system where each action/tool key maps to allow/ask/deny (or fine-grained pattern objects), letting a lead control which actions require approval, plus a bypass flag for skipping prompts entirely. However, there is no explicit mention of controlling external tool/integration access specifically (e.g., MCP servers, third-party APIs) versus general command/file actions, and no independent verification of this control working as intended. Missing for 10: explicit external-tool/integration allowlisting docs, enterprise/org-level policy enforcement, independent/hands-on confirmation of permission controls.
